actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to any Proxycurl endpoint.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_company_profile.description: Fetch a LinkedIn company profile from Proxycurl.
actions.get_company_profile.props.url.de: LinkedIn company URL, for example https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/
actions.get_person_profile.description: Fetch a LinkedIn person profile from Proxycurl.
actions.get_person_profile.props.linkedi: Public LinkedIn profile URL, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates
actions.lookup_person_email.description: Lookup the work email address for a LinkedIn person profile.
actions.lookup_person_email.props.callba: Optional webhook URL for async completion callbacks from Proxycurl.
actions.lookup_person_email.props.linked: Public LinkedIn profile URL to enrich.
actions.search_people.description: Search for people in Proxycurl using lightweight keyword filters.
actions.search_people.props.country.desc: Optional country filter, for example us, gb, or sg.
actions.search_people.props.headline.des: Optional keywords expected in the person headline.
actions.search_people.props.summary_keyw: Optional keywords expected in the summary/about section.
auth.description:
To use Proxycurl:
1. Sign in to your Proxycurl account at https://nubela.co/proxycurl.
2. Open your dashboard and copy your API key.
3. Paste the API key here.

Authentication note:
- Proxycurl's public SDK/docs show Bearer token authorization for API requests.
description: Enrich LinkedIn people and company profiles with Proxycurl.
